# Owner + Classifier + Noun · *Owner + Classifier + Noun*

**Meaning:** my / your / her (a specific thing) · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Possession and description

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fclassifier-possessive).

Instead of 嘅, Cantonese often joins an owner to a specific thing with its classifier: 我部手機 is 'my phone', 佢間屋 is 'her flat'. This is very common in everyday speech.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我部手機冇電喇。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 din6 laa3. |
| Yale | ngóh bouh sáu gēi móuh dihn la. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄅㄛㄨ⁶ ㄙㄜㄨ² ㄍㄝㄧ¹ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㄉㄧㄣ⁶ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | My phone's battery is dead. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你架車好靚。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 gaa3 ce1 hou2 leng3. |
| Yale | néih ga chē hóu leng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄍㄚ³ ㄘㄝ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄌㄝㄥ³. |
| English | Your car is lovely. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢間屋喺沙田。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 gaan1 uk1 hai2 saa1 tin4. |
| Yale | kéuih gāan ūk hái sā tìhn. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄍㄚㄣ¹ ㄨㆶ¹ ㄏㄜㄧ² ㄙㄚ¹ ㄊㄧㄣ⁴. |
| English | Her flat is in Sha Tin. |
